title: Electrical Talent Acquisition Manager — Covington, Georgia
location_policy: Local-only discovery centered on Covington and Metro Atlanta until the user explicitly expands scope. Include out-of-area candidates only when a candidate-authored post or statement explicitly expresses plans or intent to relocate to Metro Atlanta. Do not conduct nationwide discovery or infer relocation interest from generic willingness to move. Verify the Covington in-person commute separately.

geographic_scope.out_of_area_exception: Explicit candidate-authored Metro Atlanta relocation intent, with source URL, excerpt and signal date preserved
geographic_scope.origin_restriction: None for candidates satisfying the explicit Metro Atlanta relocation exception

tracks.qualification_note: Title alone is insufficient. Require demonstrated skilled-trades recruiting; electrical recruiting and commercial electrical understanding are preferred rather than hard exclusion gates.

compensation.flexibility: Some flexibility above $70,000; no higher ceiling specified. Record expectations for employer review rather than automatically excluding above-target prospects.

start_basis: User explicitly confirmed immediate start during profile refinement.
travel_pay_basis: Carried forward from prior user instructions; no travel allowance specified in the posting.
relocation: Employer will help relocate; amount and terms unspecified. Current discovery remains local, with exceptions only for candidates explicitly mentioning Metro Atlanta relocation. Verify timing and in-person Covington willingness.
required_evidence: Experience recruiting skilled trades; electrical field recruiting is preferred
Ability to interview skilled-trades candidates and assess experience, skills and field fit
Ability to assess appropriate pay rates based on experience and skill level
Ownership of full-cycle recruiting, proactive sourcing and an ongoing candidate pipeline
Collaboration with project managers, superintendents, foremen and leadership on manpower needs

preferred_experience.note: Electrical recruiting and three years of commercial electrical experience are preferred, not mandatory. Broader skilled-trades recruiters are eligible; record electrical knowledge and technical-interview gaps for review. Do not require a manager title, college degree or electrician license absent further user instruction.

responsibilities: Recruit electricians, foremen and other skilled field roles through the full hiring process
Source through job boards, referrals, social media, trade schools and industry relationships
Conduct phone and in-person interviews and assess field capability before presentation to leadership
Plan for current and upcoming project manpower needs
Maintain a qualified pipeline and local electrical/skilled-trades relationships
Develop recruiting strategies, coordinate offers and support new-hire transitions
Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate communication
Track recruiting activity, hiring outcomes and effective sources

ab_requires: Evidence of this candidate's skilled-trades recruiting fit; electrical experience is preferred and reported separately
Credible candidate-specific job-seeking evidence with a confirmed original signal date within the last 30 days
Metro Atlanta residence or explicit candidate-authored intent to relocate to Metro Atlanta; relocation intent alone does not prove job-seeking
Identity and signal subject confirmed; later contradictory availability evidence reviewed
readiness_to_record_separately: Salary expectations against a $70,000 target with some flexibility; higher expectations require employer review
In-person Covington commute or supported relocation
Earliest start date relative to immediate need
signal_exclusions: A recruiter advertising vacancies or sourcing candidates is not evidence that the recruiter wants a job
Employer hiring ads, staffing-agency sales pitches and recruiter service advertisements
Undated Open To Work headlines and old resumes without a recent original statement
Index refresh, retrieval, publication metadata or a third-party like used as the candidate's signal date
A matching name alone used to merge identities or corroborate availability

activation.note: Descriptive profile fields are not all enforced by the current runtime. Review recruiter-specific discovery, follow-ups and screening before activation. Do not reuse electrician launch scripts or expired sessions.

research_constraints.budget_policy: Use the existing cumulative ledger and all lower run, session, provider and runtime guards. Preserve the $100 POC ceiling. The prior $30 authorization does not itself activate a new run or override existing limits.
